name: rental-rates
title: Rental rates
description: Rental pricing by period: day, weekend, week and month rates, the cheapest mix for the dates picked, and the refundable deposit apart.
docs: Pass rates as the price of one whole period in minor units: { day: 3500, weekend: 9000, week: 18000, month: 52000 }; leave out what you do not offer. A weekend is Friday to Sunday (Saturday and Sunday count too), a week is 7 days and a month is 30. The cheapest combination for the days picked is worked out exactly (it may buy a week for six days, or a week and three days), and the breakdown names every line, with what it saves against the day rate in a sentence such as '3 days at the weekend rate saves €15.00'. Every rate shows what one day costs on it. range and onRangeChange control the dates (Dates at midnight, like the house date pickers; range also takes a plain '2026-11-20' string), or leave them out and pass defaultRange. unavailable lists the booked days as Dates or strings: they are struck through, cannot be picked, and while the return day is chosen the days after the next booking are refused too; the booked days of the month are named under the calendar. min is the first day that can be rented. Choosing a rate fills in the dates for one whole period from the pick-up day, or from today, moving to the next stretch where it is free and saying so under the chosen dates in the summary, so the calendar stays where it is. deposit is shown apart from the total and described as refundable. The total is a polite status. labels holds every word; pricing.ts holds the arithmetic and runs on the server too.
